working_tree_mode: W5.3 changes remain uncommitted on top of the committed W5.0-W5.2 baseline

implemented_scope.delivery: packaged same-origin HTML, CSS and ES module assets served by the single FastAPI app
implemented_scope.frontend_dependencies: no Node.js build, CDN, frontend framework or second service
implemented_scope.task_flow: submit a research query, list and reopen Runs, inspect user-facing state, progress and budget, cancel, and choose one of two explicit unknown-effect recovery decisions
implemented_scope.result_flow: read registered Delivery text, Evidence details, limitations, unmet criteria and recovery actions
implemented_scope.events: consume persisted SSE updates and refresh authoritative Run snapshots
implemented_scope.artifact_content: Run-scoped registered Delivery Artifact only; content hash verification, 2 MB display limit and UTF-8 gate
implemented_scope.responsive_layout: desktop workbench and mobile single-column layout without horizontal page overflow

retained_failures.cause: Starlette TestClient required the unavailable httpx2 package.
retained_failures.decision: Do not add a W5.3 runtime or dev dependency; use existing ASGI endpoint-direct contracts and real fixture Uvicorn browser acceptance.

retained_failures.result: HTML and CSS loaded but the ES module did not execute
retained_failures.cause: Windows MIME mapping served app.js as text/plain and the browser enforced module MIME requirements.
retained_failures.fix: Register .js as text/javascript and version static asset URLs to invalidate the cached response.
